_comment: Scraper slugs the daily audit should NOT flag as broken when they emit zero events. Two kinds: aggregators that emit child slugs under different names (no `until`), and venues that are legitimately empty between seasons (verified by hand). Every non-aggregator entry carries `until` (YYYY-MM-DD): the date by which the reason stops being true — the next season, semester or edition — or, for undated reasons, a recheck deadline. Past that date the exemption lapses and the audit flags the slug again, so a stale 'Sommerpause' can't hide a broken parser. Add a slug here only after confirming the source genuinely has no upcoming events.

alabama-kino.reason: closed for rebuilding — the cinema shut on 31 Aug 2026 for the ~2-year Kampnagel refurbishment and reopens with two screens (notice on alabama-kino.de). Its kinotickets.express listing renders "Keine Vorstellungen" for every date filter; parser verified against that live page.

alsterdorf-sommerkino.reason: seasonal — open-air summer cinema on Alsterdorfer Markt; the 2026 season ran 14 Aug – 11 Sep and is over. Parser verified live: it still extracts all 5 2026 screenings with titles and times, they are simply all past.

bad-vilbel-open-air-kino.reason: seasonal — summer open-air cinema in the Freibad; the oak-26 season ran 22 Jul – 9 Aug 2026 and is over. Parser verified against the live Gatsby page-data: all 15 oak-26 films and their dates still parse, they are simply all past.

bnai-brith-frankfurt.reason: network-unreachable — site returns HTTP 503 service unavailable

buergeruniversitaet.reason: semester break — the Goethe-Uni Tribe API still filters by category, but the Vorträge/Diskussionen/Podiumsgespräch/Science-Talk categories hold exactly one event after 1 Aug 2026 (Kinder-Uni, 7 Sep), now past; the winter-term programme is not yet published. Verified live against each category id.

cafe-mutz.reason: seasonal — FilmClub in Sommerpause after July 1, 2026 (last screening); category-4 WP REST API still returns no future posts as of 24 Sep 2026.

deichtorhallen.reason: aggregator — fans out to child slugs: deichtorhallen-phoxxi, deichtorhallen-halle-aktuelle-kunst, deichtorhallen-sammlung-falckenberg

deutsches-apotheken-museum.reason: sporadic — the Heidelberg museum lists public events one at a time; /fuehrungen/oeffentliche-veranstaltungen carried a single teaser (Workshop Duftmedizin, 08.08.2026) which is now past. Parser verified against the live listing + detail markup ('Datum: Samstag, 08. August 2026' parses to 2026-08-08).

dig-frankfurt.reason: seasonal — summer pause; last listed event was 30 Jun 2026 ('Der lange Arm der Mullahs'); the Tribe Events API still returns no upcoming events as of 24 Sep 2026.

fes-hessen.reason: sporadic — Landesbüro Hessen only occasionally hosts events in Frankfurt; the listing (Jun 2026) had events in Hanau, Steinbach, Wiesbaden etc. but none in Frankfurt

fgz-streitclub.reason: between editions — the StreitClub runs a handful of evenings a year at the English Theatre; #19 was 7 Sep 2026 and the next date is unannounced. Parser verified against the live RSS feed: all 9 dated items still parse.

forschungskolleg-humanwissenschaften.reason: between programme blocks — FKH archive/events showed no upcoming dates after 2 Jul 2026; on 24 Sep 2026 the site answered HTTP 500.

freiluftkino-frankfurt.reason: seasonal — open-air cinema, no programme outside the summer season (verified live: 0 events)

hamburger-puppentheater.reason: seasonal — Sommerpause; the new season was due to start in September 2026, so a zero after that means the Reservix source needs rechecking.

hamburger-studienbibliothek.reason: sporadic — small critical-theory library (studienbibliothek.org); avant-garde 'Bibliothekskonzerte' + occasional talks published only as prose in the index news feed, extracted via the AI proxy into html-events-cache.ts (refresh-html-cache.ts). Latest listed event was 22 Jun 2026; often empty between events.

hamburgmusik.reason: aggregator — fans out to child slugs: elbphilharmonie, laeiszhalle

imd-darmstadt.reason: biennial — Darmstädter Ferienkurse run in odd years (last 2025, next 10–24 Jul 2027); the festival/programm pages still show the 2025 edition and carry no ztix booking links, so there are no upcoming ticketed events between editions. The shared ztix parser is verified against the other Darmstadt venues.

jazz-palmengarten.reason: seasonal — Palmengarten summer jazz series, silent off-season (verified live: 0 events)

jazzkeller.reason: stale source — live.html (Brizy CMS) still shows 'SEASON SPRING 2026' with the last dated show in June as of 24 Sep 2026; nothing newer is published there.

karl-marx-buchhandlung.reason: sporadic — bookshop often has no events booked beyond the next few weeks

landinsicht-buchladen.reason: network-unreachable — the bookshop's site answers HTTP 500 to every request (24 Sep 2026)

lichtmess-kino.reason: seasonal — small volunteer arthouse between programmes; /programm lists nothing after 12 Jun 2026 (parser verified working on the past rows).

mathildenhoehe.reason: between exhibitions — both /ausstellungen/aktuell/ and /ausstellungen/vorschau/ render the empty marker ('Es sind derzeit keine Ausstellungen in dieser Kategorie eingetragen') as of 24 Jun 2026; the site lists no current or upcoming exhibitions. Parser verified — it keys off that marker and the <article> list.

museums-frankfurt.reason: aggregator — fans out to the per-museum slugs

museums-hamburg.reason: aggregator — fans out to child slugs: altonaer-museum, jenisch-haus, speicherstadtmuseum, museum-der-arbeit, deutsches-hafenmuseum, museum-fuer-hamburgische-geschichte

museumsuferfest.reason: annual — the festival ran 28–30 Aug 2026; its ndsdestinationdataevent sitemap still lists only that edition, so every parsed event is past. The scraper fans out to the riverside museums' own slugs during the festival.

nippon-connection.reason: seasonal — annual late-May/early-June film festival; empty between editions (2026 edition ran 2–7 Jun)

openbooks-frankfurt.reason: seasonal — annual October festival; empty the rest of the year

orfeos-erben.reason: verified live: source lists no upcoming events

pupille.reason: semester break — the Uni-Kino's /api/screenings/semester feed ends with the 10 Sep 2026 screening; the winter-semester programme is not yet published.

roemerberggespraeche.reason: seasonal — lecture series runs ~twice a year; empty between editions

taunale-oberursel.reason: annual — TAUNALE Taunus Filmfest ran 5–9 Aug 2026 (gcal CTA 'dates=20260805/20260810'); the scraper deliberately emits nothing once an edition has ended, until the next edition's dates are published.

theater-fuer-kinder.reason: unreachable — TLS cert invalid on own site, Reservix subdomain returns a generic page

tu-darmstadt-vortraege.reason: sporadic — the central calendar only shows ~two weeks ahead and the scraper keeps only lecture-keyword items; on 24 Sep 2026 its 15 listed items (disputations, workshops, a guest talk) contained none. Parser verified: all 15 items parse.

uni-heidelberg-ringvorlesung.reason: between semesters — the Ruperto Carola series ran Sommersemester 2026 (11 May – 20 Jul); the Wintersemester 2026/27 programme is not yet on the landing page. Parser verified: it still extracts all 8 SoSe date blocks with titles from the live page.

wdc2026.reason: aggregator — fans out to wdc2026-* child slugs

ypsilon-buchladen.reason: seasonal — bookshop reading programme between seasons; last events were May 2026, next programme was expected late summer 2026

zeise-open-air.reason: seasonal — the Altona Rathaus courtyard open-air ran 1 Jul – 30 Aug 2026; the /openairprogramm page keeps the intro copy but drops the screening rows off-season (verified live: 0 view-grouping-header / tagesprogramm blocks). The indoor Zeise programme is covered separately via Cineamo (zeise-kinos).
